translations.name: Foundational Community Supports (FCS)
translations.description: FCS is a free Apple Health (Medicaid) service for people 16 and older who have complex health needs. Supportive Housing helps you find a home and keep it. Supported Employment helps you find a job and keep it. You, a provider, or someone helping you can send a referral to get started.
translations.website_description: Housing and employment support for Apple Health members, plus the FCS referral form.
